 📜 RULES 
 🆕 Build a new project. Previously completed projects are not eligible.
 Do Not Submit Multiple Projects. 
 🤝 Respect everyone. Racism, hate speech, harassment, discrimination, and offensive content are not allowed.
 🔐 Respect privacy and security. Do not create projects that intentionally violate someone's privacy or security.
 ©️ Respect intellectual property. Respect copyright, trademarks, licenses, and other intellectual-property rights.
 🤖 AI tools are allowed. You may use AI-assisted development tools while building your project.
 🧩 Existing tools are allowed. Libraries, APIs, frameworks, datasets, and open-source projects may be used.
 👥 Solo or team participation is allowed. 
 ⚠️ Rule violations may result in disqualification at the organizers' discretion.
